title: ROADMAP-1: QNFO.OPS #MCP-OWNER-READS-2: follow-up filed with a closing probe
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=site/agentic.js
code-anchor: export const LIVE_TOOLS

**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** weekly product-manager pass; the roadmap item is taken by the executor when it is next in driver order
**Program:** QNFO.OPS
**Metric it should move:** owner_load
**Cost rule:** adds no worker, cron or paid model call.
**Done check:** grep:site/agentic.js::get_standards ; merged and verified live: POST https://ultrastable.io/mcp tools/list expect "get_blind_spots"
**Status:** closed

Expose get_blind_spots and get_standards as MCP read tools by publishing doctrine/blindspots.json and seed/standards/standards.json into the snapshot the Worker already reads (no new cron: the existing snapshot job includes them).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 157.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
